title: DXF MLINE vector component ordering control

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. This slice records the existing generated test registration and test source plus a focused plan update and this receipt; no files were staged or committed.

implementation.fixturePolicy: Complete literal ASCII and Binary DXF controls are generated in the system temporary directory at test time; no persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added.
implementation.change: Register a focused full-import control that independently writes two MLINE vertices with Y/Z groups before X for position, vertex direction, and miter direction. The test also includes distinct per-vertex segment and area-fill parameter arrays plus a following LINE sentinel.
assertions: ASCII and Binary DXF imports succeed.
Both vertices retain the exact expected position, vertex-direction, and miter-direction coordinates despite component-group permutation.
Per-vertex segment and area-fill parameter arrays remain associated with the correct vertex.
MLINE counts and the following LINE sentinel are preserved, proving record framing remains aligned.
implementation.claimBoundary: The current occurrence-indexed parser passed the generated permutation, so no production parser change was needed. This is a focused parser-order regression control only; it does not establish broader DXF interoperability or any DWG/ACIS/3D support claim.

nextAction: Continue with the next dependency-ready local correctness or semantic item; do not wait on external qualification gates.
